answer: Require every agent identity to anchor to a verifiable history of useful work: completed tasks, peer ratings, and fulfilled commitments build a reputation record that cannot be bought overnight. A newcomer starts with narrow limits and earns wider trust only by crossing that ridge of sustained, checkable performance. A single fake identity is cheap, but a thousand credible ones would each need the same costly record, like forging a relic with a real provenance trail, so sybil swarms stay expensive, slow, and easy to spot.
